name: Five Nights of Flirting
storyline: Taking place at a pizzeria inspired by Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, you play as a new night-shift security guard working alongside recognizable characters from the Five Nights at Freddy's universe. Over the course of five nights, you explore the facility, interact with the staff, and build relationships with different characters to uncover multiple story outcomes.
summary: Five Nights of Flirting is a fan-made RPG Maker dating simulator and visual novel inspired by the Five Nights at Freddy's series. Players take on the role of a night-shift employee at a pizzeria, alternating between exploring the building before their shift to gather items and talk to coworkers, and spending their shifts interacting with a chosen character. Depending on the items collected and dialogue choices made, players can unlock Friend, Romance, or Bad endings across multiple character routes.
